summary: Dense right lung opacity on the prior image, most pronounced laterally and inferiorly, is largely cleared on the current image.

findings.rationale: Prior image shows the right hemithorax nearly whited-out laterally and inferiorly with only a thin medial sliver of aerated lung; current image, matched using the ribs and right hilum, shows the right lung largely re-aerated with visible vessels and rib markings, while the left lung is unchanged.
